CIV.note: Only CNI enrolment of children from age 5 is stated; no authentication service.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
Nothing stated on digital civil registration of births or deaths.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
CNI enrolment starts at age 5, not a number given at birth registration.
Nothing stated on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: ONECI, Cote d'Ivoire's national identification office, now enrols children from age 5 for the biometric national identity card (CNI), according to its communique reported by Linfodrome.

CIV.note: No local civil registration office entry is described.
